export_roundtrip.sampling: rest plus five matched integer-frame samples per clip
export_roundtrip.scope: pipeline-output-to-export; not anatomical or source-import certification

modular_character.imported_normal_validation: source-to-float32 input proof and deterministic isolated Blender codec replay
modular_character.sampling: unmodified source rest corners and deterministic all-joint compound pose
modular_character.color_channel_order: render-active color first, remaining source layers in declaration order

source.topology_weld: coincident positions rounded in the same height-normalized frame; observation only
source.scope: Surface/topology diagnostics; no reference morphology or anatomical certificate

candidate.topology_weld: coincident positions rounded in the same height-normalized frame; observation only
candidate.scope: Surface/topology diagnostics; no reference morphology or anatomical certificate

lod.skin_transfer: Nearest original triangle, nonnegative normalized barycentric weights, then measured top-four pruning; decimator weight interpolation discarded
lod.scope: Source LOD approximation only; existing source creases/topology observations remain disclosed. UVs are interpolated by collapse, not rebaked. No renderer, collider or licence admission.

budget.scope: Same pre-existing source/LOD surface budgets applied to every rest/posed sample. No visual/consumer admission. Capture completeness is separately required.

pose_fidelity.scope: Finite bidirectional samples of source versus LOD triangles, not continuous Hausdorff/silhouette proof. Preserves existing source defects; does not certify anatomical quality.

rights.scope: Repository declaration is not an automatic blanket grant over generated assets or source inputs.

scope: New producer candidate. Frozen full-body and older skins untouched; pre-existing held/presence creases remain. Consumer native/missing/equipment/walk/leg/physics/rights gates are separate.
